project.description: Packages the PSAMA image from the per-stack reactor lane (converted from Jenkinsfile.fence, which is no longer referenced).

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}" AUTH_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-auth-microapp" MODULE="services/pic-sure-auth-microapp/pic-sure-auth-services" STAMP="$MAVEN_WS/build-info/$(printf '%s' "$MODULE" | tr '/' '_').txt"
# Guard: this job does not compile. It needs this module's own jar plus the stamp written # for this module, so a lane whose last build targeted a different module cannot mislabel # this image with a commit that never built this jar. if [ ! -f "$STAMP" ] \ || ! ls "$AUTH_DIR"/pic-sure-auth-services/target/pic-sure-auth-services-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no current artifacts for $MODULE on stack ${TARGET_STACK} -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' with MODULES=$MODULE first" exit 2 fi # shellcheck source=/dev/null . "$STAMP"
docker build --load \ -f "$AUTH_DIR/pic-sure-auth-services/bdc.Dockerfile" \ --build-arg DATASOURCE_URL="${DATASOURCE_URL}" \ --build-arg DATASOURCE_USERNAME="${DATASOURCE_USERNAME}" \ --build-arg STACK_SPECIFIC_APPLICATION_ID="${STACK_SPECIFIC_APPLICATION_ID}" \ -t "hms-dbmi/psama:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$AUTH_DIR" docker save "hms-dbmi/psama:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > psama.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp psama.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/psama.tar.gz" --metadata "git-commit=${GIT_COMMIT_FULL}"
